scenes.headline: How key presses steer a video world model
scenes.sub: XGEN-JING's control vector, its injectors, and its seventeen-frame clock.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Kelp! Jing turns key presses and prompts into first-person video, with sound. Here's what the keys drive.

scenes.text: Six numbers from the keyboard modulate every one of fifty transformer layers, through injectors that start at zero so control trains into a finished model.
scenes.say: The idea: six numbers reach all fifty layers, through injectors that start at zero, so control trains into a finished model.

steps.say: Keys fill a six-slot camera vector. Since a September fix, four are live: forward, strafe, pitch and yaw. Rise and roll stay zero.
A shared encoder lifts six numbers to five hundred and twelve. Fifty injectors, one per layer, turn that into scale and shift.
Each modulates its layer's hidden state, in one trunk that carries prompt, video and audio. Even dialogue arrives as text.
Scale and shift start at zero, so each injector does nothing at first: the ControlNet trick. About three hundred million parameters, under one percent.

scenes.title: One opening, three action chunks
scenes.credit: the project's own demo reel; checkpoint unstated

steps.say: Here it is in the project's own reel: one shared opening frame, at the top.
Below, three action chunks: navigation, action, communication. Each steers its own continuation. Which checkpoint rendered it, the reel doesn't say.

parts.note: frames per control slice: 0.708 s at 24 fps
parts.say: One control slice is seventeen frames: point seven oh eight seconds, at twenty-four frames a second.

parts.note: slices across every chunk: 21 in the bakery example, 362 frames
parts.say: Times the slices. The bakery example sums to twenty-one: three hundred and sixty-two frames.

steps.label: This release: every frame attends to every frame
steps.say: Attention runs both ways over the whole clip. Frame one depends on the last, so it arrives with the last.

steps.label: A causal model: announced as coming soon
steps.say: A causal model, coming soon, could emit frames as it goes. Even then, a key press waits for the next slice.

scenes.text: Behind six numbers sits a lot of model: fifty injectors, one per layer, on a seventeen-frame clock.
scenes.say: Behind six numbers sits a lot of model: fifty injectors, on a seventeen-frame clock.

recap: Keys fill a six-slot vector; four are live
Fifty zero-initialised injectors, one per layer
One slice is 17 frames; no frame comes early
scenes.say: To recap: six numbers, fifty injectors that start at zero, and a seventeen-frame clock.
